items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: And does Wilburn play an instrument now? No. Wilburn sings. He was a banjo player.

ctx.x: In fact I happened to be listening to the band. Yeah. In fact I happened to be listening to the band. He was the band. He was the band. He was the band. He was the band. He was the band. He was trying to get the band down here for the New Orleans Jazz and Heritage Festival. But something like that makes too much sense. So they didn't bring it down.

Yeah. In fact I happened to be listening to that band this morning but on the old McKinney Cotton Pickers, not the new ones. And does Wilburn play an instrument now? No. Wilburn sings. He was a banjo player. Was he? Yeah.

They have two units. They're using a small unit and a large unit. Tommy Saunders is playing trumpet with him sometimes. And Tommy's a wonderful player. And there's some awfully good musicians in the Detroit area too, so I imagine that they can put together some very fine bands. Yeah.
